content.value: Many familiar creatures have custom RPG attributes and are substantially tougher than their vanilla versions. Do not judge an encounter from the vanilla heart count alone: enemies can carry Armor, Evasion, [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], elemental resistances, critical stats, damage conversion, penetration, leech, and ailment chances.

Undead: [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]], [[mob/minecraft:husk|Husk]], [[mob/minecraft:drowned|Drowned]], [[mob/minecraft:zombie_villager|Zombie Villager]], [[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeleton]], [[mob/minecraft:stray|Stray]], [[mob/minecraft:bogged|Bogged]], and [[mob/minecraft:wither_skeleton|Wither Skeleton]].
Arthropods: [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spider]], [[mob/minecraft:cave_spider|Cave Spider]], [[mob/minecraft:silverfish|Silverfish]], and [[mob/minecraft:endermite|Endermite]].
Raiders and casters: [[mob/minecraft:pillager|Pillager]], [[mob/minecraft:vindicator|Vindicator]], [[mob/minecraft:witch|Witch]], [[mob/minecraft:evoker|Evoker]], [[mob/minecraft:vex|Vex]], and [[mob/minecraft:ravager|Ravager]].
Nether threats: [[mob/minecraft:blaze|Blaze]], [[mob/minecraft:magma_cube|Magma Cube]], [[mob/minecraft:ghast|Ghast]], [[mob/minecraft:zombified_piglin|Zombified Piglin]], [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]], [[mob/minecraft:piglin_brute|Piglin Brute]], [[mob/minecraft:hoglin|Hoglin]], [[mob/minecraft:zoglin|Zoglin]], and [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]].
Other hostile threats: [[mob/minecraft:creeper|Creeper]], [[mob/minecraft:guardian|Guardian]], [[mob/minecraft:phantom|Phantom]], [[mob/minecraft:breeze|Breeze]], [[mob/minecraft:enderman|Enderman]], [[mob/minecraft:shulker|Shulker]], and [[mob/minecraft:slime|Slime]].
Defensive or neutral creatures: [[mob/minecraft:iron_golem|Iron Golem]], [[mob/minecraft:snow_golem|Snow Golem]], [[mob/minecraft:polar_bear|Polar Bear]], [[mob/minecraft:wolf|Wolf]], and [[mob/minecraft:armadillo|Armadillo]].

Use the overhead entity display to read current health and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] and to recognize ailments. Armor is strongest against small physical hits but less efficient against very large hits; high Evasion can avoid entity-sourced attacks; resistances specialize a creature against particular elements. Negative resistance is a vulnerability. [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] and [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]] prevent movement and pause supported mob attack cooldowns while active.

[[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]]: 60 maximum health, 12 attack damage, 30 Armor, -25% [[stat/cranks-dungeons:fire_resistance|fire resistance]], and 15% Chance to [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]].
[[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeleton]]: 45 maximum health, 14 attack damage, 10 Armor, 40 Evasion, -25% [[stat/cranks-dungeons:fire_resistance|fire resistance]], faster projectiles, and enhanced critical stats.
[[mob/minecraft:wolf|Wolf]]: 60 maximum health, 16 attack damage, 20 Armor, 45 Evasion, [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] chance, and enhanced critical stats before wolf armor is considered.
[[mob/minecraft:armadillo|Armadillo]]: 30 maximum health, 150 Armor, full knockback resistance, and 50% reduced critical damage taken.
Equipment worn by an Act 1 zombie, skeleton, or piglin adds its own base stats and runes on top of the creature's built-in attributes. See Mob Equipment for generation and drop chances.
